jobs.detail: SIDE BEND OVER STABILITY BALL, TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side same camera/model/scale. FRONT-side three-quarter view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT. Lie on LEFT SIDE with LEFT lateral hip/waist supported over top of one full large round gray stability ball. BOTH legs extended toward RIGHT, both shoes firmly braced on FLOOR in a slightly staggered stance for balance, no feet floating. Hands lightly behind ears elbows open, no pull on neck. SAME hips/ball/legs/feet position in both phases, only upper trunk laterally flexes. LEFT LOWER: left side torso drapes over LEFT/top edge of ball, shoulders/head lowered toward image-left floor, spine bends sideways gently over ball. RIGHT LIFT: contract upper right side waist to lift shoulders/head UP toward ceiling until torso nearer straight alignment with pelvis, no forward sit-up/no twisting. Face/chest stay toward camera both, ball under hip/waist not chest, neck aligned torso. Abdomen red only ONE diffuse smooth BLURRED teaching tint over intact side abdominal shirt, no fibers/rays. Exposed arms/calves detailed grayscale, full opaque shirt/shorts front sides back seat crotch. Full ball/head/elbows/shoes within margins.

jobs.detail: FOREARM SIDE PLANK TOP-KNEE TUCK, TWO equal SQUARE panels same fixed front-side three-quarter camera/model. LEFT FOREARM flat on thin gray mat with elbow under shoulder, left bottom leg straight and outer left shoe grounded, hips raised so shoulder-hip-bottom heel straight line with clear air gap under hip. RIGHT hand rests on right hip. LEFT START: RIGHT TOP LEG straight, raised slightly10degrees above bottom leg, top shoe off floor, bottom leg/forearm stable. RIGHT TUCK: same LEFT bottom leg remains STRAIGHT grounded at outer shoe, hips stay lifted sameheight; flex RIGHT top hip/knee and bring right KNEE FORWARD TOWARD CHEST, knee near belly, right foot lifted forward near bottom thigh/knee. Only top leg changes, no bottom knee bends, no knee touching floor, no hip sag. Top thigh must project FORWARD toward head not merely upward; right knee bent90degrees or more. SAME top leg identity across phases, both legs clearly continuous from hips through knees/shoes, no extra limb. Upper body/forearm/pelvis unchanged. Diffuse smooth abdominal red tint over intact opaque black shirt, no anatomical muscle divisions on fabric. Fine exposed grayscale arm/calf anatomy. Whole body in frame, no bench/ball.
